entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie... I hope you can help me. I need to make a return. I have my order number if you need it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can you please provide me with the order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I just... I feel so silly about this whole thing.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line Cycling Jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It's the wrong size. I saved up for that jersey, and I was so excited, but it's just too tight. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was just really disappointed it didn't fit right.
I'm very sorry to hear that it wasn't a perfect fit for you. I see here the order was delivered about 69 days ago. Let me just check our policy for you.

Oh no, has it been that long? I've just been going through some things... I was really hoping I could get an exchange or a refund. I honestly really needed this money back if an exchange isn't possible. It would help me out a lot.

I understand completely. Please hold on for just one moment... Okay, I have good news. Since the jersey is a standard apparel item, it's covered by our 90-day return window. You are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? You can still help? That is such a huge relief. Thank you, thank you.
Of course. We can definitely process an exchange for a different size, or if you prefer, a full refund to your original payment method. Which would you prefer?
I think I'd just like the refund for now, please. This is such a weight off my shoulders.

Not a problem at all. I have just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just package the jersey, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been so helpful, Charlie. I really appreciate it.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
